title: Deployment problem
body:
### First Check

- [X] I added a very descriptive title here.
- [X] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it.
- [X] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search.
- [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information.
- [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer.
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc).

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
[project]
name = "fastapi-practice"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Add your description here"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.13"
dependencies = [
    "fastapi[standard]>=0.135.2",
]
[tool.fastapi]
entrypoint = "backend/main:app"
```


### Description

I was trying to deploy my first fastapi app, and I have been struggling this error message, which I tried several solutions to resolve it but still persisting 

```
0.098 error: Failed to parse: `pyproject.toml`
0.098   Caused by: TOML parse error at line 1, column 246
0.098   |
0.098 1 | 
0.098   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ^
0.098 key with no value, expected `=`
------
Dockerfile:44
--------------------
  43 |     # Ref: https://docs.docker.com/reference/dockerfile#run---mounttypecache
  44 | >>> RUN --mount=type=bind,from=builder-context,source=install_dependencies.sh,target=/tmp/install_dependencies.sh \
  45 | >>>     --mount=type=bind,from=python-cache-stage,source=/py,target=${UV_PYTHON_CACHE_DIR},readwrite \
  46 | >>>     --mount=type=cache,id=uv-${TEAM_ID},sharing=shared,target=/root/.cache/uv \
  47 | >>>     /tmp/install_dependencies.sh
  48 |     
--------------------
error: failed to solve: process "/bin/sh -c /tmp/install_dependencies.sh" did not complete successfully: exit code: 2
```

### Operating System

Linux

### Operating System Details

I am using WSL(ubuntu distro) through Vscode.

### FastAPI Version

0.135.2

### Pydantic Version

2.12.5

### Python Version

3.13.12

### Additional Context

_No response_
